hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 custom swap curve between ETH and phiEth by intercepting swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta: it takes the input token from the PoolManager, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert, then settles the output, fully bypassing concentrated liquidity. Liquidity additions are blocked unconditionally, and the hook only initializes on zero-fee ETH/phiEth pools.
